sources.title: 2026 FX Administration Internet Information — Personal FX (08): How do overseas individuals repatriate labor income earned in China?
sources.used_for: Overseas individuals' lawful current-account CNY income: valid ID + transaction-amount/source evidence including tax vouchers at the bank (citing Huifa [2020] No. 14, Art. 59).

sources.title: Foreign currency and currency exchange rates
sources.used_for: U.S. tax items must be translated into functional currency (generally USD) at the rate prevailing when received/paid/accrued.

sources.title: Yearly average currency exchange rates
sources.used_for: China Yuan 2025 yearly average 7.129; IRS has no official exchange rate; spot rate generally used. Reference rate only, not an executable bank quote.

sources.title: 31 CFR 1010.821 — Penalty adjustment and table (penalties assessed on or after January 17, 2025)
